subject: SIG evidence delivery: SDLC artifact index + change-log clarifications
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@aurum-sec.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: sig-assessments@aurum-sec.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG / CAIQ: SDLC evidence request for Greenline Financial assessment

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. As we kick off the SIG/CAIQ validation for Greenline Financial’s integration with Redwood, we need a focused set of SDLC artifacts that demonstrate controls in four areas: code review, CI/CD gating and provenance, secrets management (rotation, access controls), and approved change management for production clusters.

Can you please provide: 
- A concise index (spreadsheet or CSV) that maps artifacts to control families (e.g., PR review evidence -> Code Review controls)
- Two representative code-review PRs with reviewer audit trail and timestamps (redact private data if needed)
- CI pipeline run excerpts showing gated builds, artifact signing or provenance markers, and the deploy approval step
- Evidence of secrets rotation policy and a recent rotation log for KMS/Vault keys used by the runtime
- The change control log for the last quarter showing approvals for production rolling updates (Jira/Change ticket references are fine)

If possible, include short pointers to the corresponding internal SOPs or Confluence pages. We don’t need full exports of logs — a handful of representative excerpts + the index is sufficient for the next pass.

Target timeline: can we get the index and samples by EOD Wednesday (2028-05-31)?

Thanks,
Asha Reddy
Senior Assessor — Aurum Security
asha.reddy@aurum-sec.com

--
Aurum Security conducts SIG/CAIQ mappings for cloud-native vendors.
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG / CAIQ: SDLC evidence request for Greenline Financial assessment

Marissa / Karthik / Mina —

Looping you in on an evidence request from Aurum for Greenline. They want an index + representative artifacts for code review, CI/CD gating, secrets rotation and change management. SLA: index + samples by EOD Wed.

Quick notes: 
- I pulled a provisional index from the Discovery drive and started attaching samples; see attachments I’ll upload to Drive and share (index + 4 sample files).
- Marissa: can you confirm the mapping to SIG control IDs? If you can mark which artifacts are authoritative vs. convenience copies that would help.
- Karthik: can you add a 1-paragraph note on how our pipeline signs artifacts / records provenance and confirm the Vault/KMS rotation cadence. Link to OPS-2134 change ticket for prod rolling updates is in the Drive.

Asha — we’ll send a package momentarily. If EOD Wed is tight, let us know the most critical controls to prioritize.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, GTM Security (acting)
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@aurum-sec.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG / CAIQ: SDLC evidence request for Greenline Financial assessment

Thanks Lauren — sending the curated package now. 

Attached: sdlc_artifact_index.csv (maps artifacts -> SIG/CAIQ questions), ci_cd_controls_matrix.xlsx (showing pipeline gates and approval steps), code_review_samples_PR4821.diff, k8s_change_control_log_2028Q2.xlsx, secrets-rotation-proof.txt

Notes: 
- code_review_samples_PR4821.diff: PR#4821 (repo: serving-runtime) contains the reviewer list, timestamps, and my inline remediation comments. Redacted team member emails; preserved GitHub handles and review timestamps.
- ci_cd_controls_matrix.xlsx: shows the name of the pipeline (redwood-ci-prod), the gating step (integration-tests + static analysis + artifact-sign step using sigstore), and the approval step that ties to a Jira change (OPS-2134). We use signed provenance artifacts (sigstore) stored in GCS; manifest referenced in the CI run metadata.
- secrets-rotation-proof.txt: excerpt from the rotation job run (vault-rotate-user-secrets-2028-05-17) showing rotate job start/finish and new key IDs (KMS alias preserved). Keys are managed in AWS KMS for cloud deployments and Vault for on-prem; rotation cadence is 90 days for application-level secrets, master KMS keys follow AWS CMK rotation policy.
- k8s_change_control_log_2028Q2.xlsx: includes change ticket, owner, reviewers, risk level, rollback plan, and deployment windows for the rolling updates performed in April and May.

Marissa — Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@aurum-sec.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ: SDLC evidence request for Greenline Financial assessment

Quick addendum on provenance and secrets: 

- Provenance: our CI pipeline attaches a signed OCI-like manifest for each build using sigstore; manifests include git commit SHA, builder identity (service account), and artifact digest. Example manifest references are in ci_cd_controls_matrix.xlsx (column: provenance_ref). The build job is redwood-ci-prod/build-and-sign v3.2.

- Secrets: application secrets are kept in HashiCorp Vault (namespaces per environment). Vault is mounted with AWS IAM auth for ephemeral machine identities and policies restrict read/renew to service roles. We run a monthly dry-run rotation and a full rotation every 90 days. The attached secrets-rotation-proof.txt shows the job output for the 2028-05-17 rotation.

- Change management: all production rolling updates reference a Jira change ticket and require at least two approvers from SRE and Product. OPS-2134 is the most recent, and the change control log includes timestamps for approvals.

If Aurum wants, I can extract the minimal pipeline YAML that shows the signing step (it is internal but we can redact tokens).

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@aurum-sec.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ: SDLC evidence request for Greenline Financial assessment

Lauren / team —

Received, thank you. The index and the samples look good and map cleanly to the SIG CAIQ items we expected. A couple of small follow-ups we may ask during our next review: 
- Can you provide one CI run ID (redacted as-needed) where the signed manifest and the GCS artifact are both present so we can verify the linkage end-to-end?
- For the Vault rotation proof, could you include the policy name and the KMS alias mapping in one line (we don’t need key material) so the assessor can confirm the rotation target?

If you can drop those two items into the Drive folder referenced in the index, we’ll proceed to map controls and send the preliminary SIG scorecard by next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Asha
Senior Assessor — Aurum Security
